title: API auth or scope failure
ordered_steps: isolate failing auth scope credential or tenant boundary
verify endpoint permission requirement from source refs
escalation_policy: do not request broader credentials until least-privilege gap is proven

title: Pagination or rate-limit failure
ordered_steps: isolate pagination cursor or page parameter
record response headers or retry hints when authorized
apply pagination expansion or retry wrapper
escalation_policy: switch route to queued or scheduled runtime before increasing concurrency

title: Schema drift or required-field failure
ordered_steps: isolate failing field enum or type-change boundary
compare source schema to canonical object contract
classify missing renamed enum or type-change gap
apply alias enum or required-field gate
escalation_policy: do not silently drop fields or coerce unknown enums without a receipt

title: Webhook signature or replay issue
ordered_steps: reproduce by replaying captured event in test mode
isolate signature timestamp replay or idempotency boundary
verify signature policy and timestamp window
apply webhook verify and idempotency wrappers
escalation_policy: block network write if verification or idempotency proof fails

title: Country or jurisdiction rule conflict
ordered_steps: isolate country subjurisdiction industry and effective-date scope
identify rule source and effective date
prefer official or owner-approved source hierarchy
emit conflict receipt with unresolved fields
route to human reviewer if consequential
escalation_policy: never resolve legal regulatory or safety conflicts by model confidence alone

title: Data quality outlier
ordered_steps: rerun downstream primitive on clean subset
emit quality receipt and rejected-row manifest
escalation_policy: do not mutate target systems with quarantined rows

title: Model disagreement or ambiguous extraction
ordered_steps: isolate field-level disagreement and missing citation spans
weigh source-backed claims above model vote
ask for additional source or fixture if missing
route to human reviewer when high-risk
escalation_policy: do not average incompatible claims into a served fact

title: Source staleness or effective-date gap
ordered_steps: isolate stale field source capture date and effective-date gap
escalation_policy: do not serve volatile facts with stale source receipts

title: Runtime side-effect failure
ordered_steps: isolate read write and audit effects
emit rollback or manual repair receipt
escalation_policy: stop retries when side effects are ambiguous

title: Browser selector or page drift
ordered_steps: reproduce by capturing fresh screenshot and DOM snapshot
isolate selector text-span structured-data or visual fallback boundary
emit selector drift receipt if unresolved
escalation_policy: do not trust stale selectors without a new receipt
